For most people, regular headphones are better for sound quality. Bone conduction headphones are better for outdoor awareness and keeping your ears open.

How they work
Shop

Bone conduction

Vibrations travel through your skull to your inner ear, leaving the ear canal open.

Shop

Regular headphones

Speakers send sound waves through the air into your ears, generally providing fuller sound.

Which should you choose?

Music and movies: Regular headphones.

Running or cycling outdoors: Bone conduction, because you can hear traffic and people.

Long work sessions: Depends on whether you dislike pressure in or around your ears.

Protecting your hearing: Both can cause hearing damage at high volumes. Bone conduction does not bypass this risk.

Noisy environments: Regular noise-canceling headphones are usually better.

One question: Are you comparing them mainly for hearing health, comfort, sound quality, or exercise? The recommendation changes quite a bit depending on your priority.
